description: Continue an accounting workflow response, resolve a review item, or prepare an approval action.

action.description: next reads workflow_handle (+ item_id) or workflow_state_json; resolve_review/prepare_action read review_item_json; execute_review_action books a prepared owner-expense continuation with plan_handle.

item_id.description: Stable id of a workflow item (from a workflow_action_v2 blocker or page item); action='next' returns the item after it.

plan_handle.description: For action='execute_review_action': the consume-once plan handle minted by action='prepare_action' for a server-executed owner-expense continuation. Drift-bound to the reviewed booking params; not itself approval.

review_item_json.description: Review item object for action='resolve_review' or action='prepare_action'.

rule_override_json.description: Optional explicit rule fields for action='prepare_action'.

save_as_rule.description: For action='prepare_action', prepare save_auto_booking_rule when appropriate.

workflow_handle.description: Opaque server-issued workflow handle from a compact workflow_action_v2 response. Carries inert prior workflow state; never approval or mutation authority.

workflow_state_json.description: Previous v1 workflow response; required for action='next' without workflow_handle.

name: continue_accounting_workflow
title: Continue Accounting Workflow
